description: Free: up to 3 Indonesian articles newer than a cursor, each with detected entities and an auditable sentiment score. Shows exactly what the paid GET /feed returns so an agent can evaluate before paying. Pass lang="en" for English-language coverage (entities only).

lang.description: id = Bahasa Indonesia (default), en = English-language coverage of Indonesia.

since.description: ISO 8601 time; only newer articles are returned. Omit for the latest batch.

name: indonesia_new_since
